appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'
Color scale legend from 'Low' (dark red) to 'High' (light yellow), with numerical markers at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100.
States are colored according to incidence level, with darker red indicating lower incidence and lighter yellow indicating higher incidence.
Missouri (MO) is colored light yellow, indicating high incidence.
Mississippi (MS) is colored dark red, indicating low incidence.
Delaware (DE) is colored dark red, indicating low incidence.

printed_facts.fact: The color scale ranges from 0 (Low) to 100 (High).
Missouri (MO) is shaded light yellow, corresponding to the 100 mark on the scale.
Mississippi (MS) is shaded dark red, corresponding to the 0 mark on the scale.
Delaware (DE) is shaded dark red, corresponding to the 0 mark on the scale.
